words.meaning: An abundance or generous gift, especially of food, crops, or agricultural yield.
words.sentence1: The farmers gathered in town to celebrate the autumn bounty with music and dancing. (The farmers gathered in town to celebrate the autumn bounty with music and dancing.)
words.sentence2: A rich bounty of apples and pumpkins filled the wooden crates at the village market. (A rich bounty of apples and pumpkins filled the wooden crates at the village market.)

words.meaning: The grape harvest, or the joyful season during which vineyard grapes are gathered.
words.sentence1: Todo el pueblo celebra la vendimia con cantos y bailes tradicionales. (The whole village celebrates the grape harvest with traditional songs and dances.)
words.sentence2: Durante la vendimia, los canastos rebosan de uvas maduras y dulces. (During the grape harvest, the baskets overflow with ripe and sweet grapes.)

words.meaning: The harvest of cereal crops, or the season and bountiful yield of gathering them.
words.sentence1: Apres des semaines d'effort, la moisson doree a enfin ete rassemblee dans les granges. (After weeks of effort, the golden harvest was finally gathered in the barns.)
words.sentence2: Les villageois celebrent la fin de la moisson avec un grand banquet joyeux. (The villagers celebrate the end of the harvest with a great joyful banquet.)

words.meaning: Harvest thanksgiving; the festive celebration expressing joyful gratitude for a gathered crop.
words.sentence1: Zum Erntedank schmuecken die Menschen die Altare mit frischem Brot und reifen Fruechten. (For harvest thanksgiving, people decorate the altars with fresh bread and ripe fruit.)
words.sentence2: Die frohe Gemeinde feiert den Erntedank mit Musik und einem festlichen Mahl. (The joyful community celebrates the harvest thanksgiving with music and a festive meal.)

words.meaning: A bumper crop, bountiful harvest, or abundant agricultural yield.
words.sentence1: Kotoshi wa housaku datta node mura-juu ga yorokobi ni michite iru. (Because this year was a bumper crop, the entire village is filled with joy.)
words.sentence2: Noumin-tachi wa housaku wo iwau matsuri de taiko wo tataita. (The farmers beat drums at the festival celebrating the abundant harvest.)

words.meaning: The grape harvest, marked by community festivity and the beginning of wine-making.
words.sentence1: La vendemmia porta sempre una grande allegria tra i filari della collina. (The grape harvest always brings great cheer among the hillside rows.)
words.sentence2: Tutta la famiglia si riunisce per festeggiare la ricca vendemmia con un bicchiere di vino. (The whole family gathers to celebrate the rich grape harvest with a glass of wine.)

words.meaning: A bumper harvest; an abundant crop yield that brings prosperity and celebration.
words.sentence1: Nongmin-men gechang fengshou de xiyue, tianye li yipian huanle. (The farmers sang of the joy of a bumper harvest, and the fields were filled with happiness.)
words.sentence2: Jinnian de fengshou rang zhengge cunzhuang dou chenjin zai xiqing zhong. (This year's bumper harvest immersed the entire village in celebration.)

words.meaning: A bumper harvest year; a year of abundant, joyful agricultural yield.
words.sentence1: Pungnyeon-eul majeun nongbu-deul-eun noraereul bureumyeo gikkeoi chumeul chwotta. (Welcoming a bumper year, the farmers sang and danced with delight.)
words.sentence2: Hwanggeumbit deulpani pungnyeon-ui gippeum-eul boyeojunda. (The golden field shows the joy of an abundant harvest.)

words.meaning: Joy, gladness, rejoicing, or the festive delight felt during prosperous times.
words.sentence1: Neak srok mean amnor chea khlang now pel chroht srov ban laor. (The villagers have great joy when the rice harvest turns out well.)
words.sentence2: Krom kruosar prum-preang knea daoy amnor knong rodov chroht kat. (The family gathered together with joy during the harvest season.)

words.meaning: A harvest festival; a joyous celebration and feast marking the gathering of the crops.
words.sentence1: Die hele gemeenskap kom bymekaar om die jaarlikse oesfees met sang en dans te vier. (The whole community comes together to celebrate the annual harvest festival with song and dance.)
words.sentence2: Tydens die oesfees heers daar groot dankbaarheid en vreugde op die plaas. (During the harvest festival, great gratitude and joy reign on the farm.)
